2v2 Arena is a competitive mode. Match alone or as a duo. Teammates cannot be revived. Healing effects are reduced by 70%. Over time, damage increases while healing decreases further. 

Using Deflect consumes Stamina. Landing an Execution restores Stamina. 

Most skills can be countered by Deflect. Shield-breaking Mystic Skills cannot be Deflected and deal bonus effects against defending or Deflecting targets, but can be interrupted by any skill. 

Skills (including Mystic and Charged Skills) can interrupt Light and Heavy Attacks, but not vice versa. 

Use Crowd Control breaks effectively to turn the tide. Defeating opponents earns Arena Points. High-scoring heroes will enter the Leaderboard. 

Mobile and PC players match separately. Cross-platform anomalies result in assignment to the PC queue. 

Defeat all opponents within the time limit to win. If time expires, the winner is decided by: 
1. More surviving players; 
2. Higher total damage (if survivors equal); 
3. Higher total healing (if damage equal).
